prefix: Original pixel-art game asset for a 2010s handheld (DS-era) style top-down RPG. Steep top-down 3/4 view (camera high, looking down at about 60 degrees, so we see the front face and a sliver of the top). Clean crisp chunky square pixels, flat colour shading with 2-3 tones per material, absolutely no dithering, no noise, no gradients, no anti-aliasing blur. Dark 1px outlines around shapes. Bright cheerful palette (teal-green grass, sandy paving, warm red-brown bricks). Light comes from the top-left. Entirely original design, not copied from or imitating any existing game, character or logo.
